integrity: The proof derives all lower bounds from the defining vertex constraints, separates the four possible center labels, and identifies equality conditions arm by arm. A standalone checker performs direct full-label brute force for q=4,5 and an independent exact arm-state dynamic program through q=60.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to stars whose every edge is subdivided exactly once, with at least four arms.
Unequal-arm spiders and repeated subdivisions are not covered.
Small arm counts q <= 3 have additional optimizer types and are excluded from the uniform statement.
Finite exhaustive and dynamic-programming checks are corroborative only; the all-q theorem follows from the arm-state proof.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently phrased or non-indexed exact treatment.
title: Exact signed double Italian domination of once-subdivided stars
